body: I'd rather remove that definition. There's two relevant links you may want to follow when reading this text. Following `#parsed-as-a-css-color-value` leaves the css-syntax link scrolled out of view, and the css-color link nowhere to be seen. Even if those things were both fixed, it still adds an unnecessary extra hop. I didn't want to go around fixing the existing links, though.

body: This note makes up for a flaw in the structure of the spec.  IMHO it would be better to fix the structure of the spec than to put important bits in non-normative blocks. The paragraph that starts with "Whenever the CSS value currentColor is used as a color in the CanvasRenderingContext2D API (...)" should be turned into an algorithm that is explicitly referenced by all 2d context APIs that need to parse color values (e.g. this, fillStyle, strokeStyle)
